comment: FHIR is described as delivering the syntactic and structural layer of interoperability. FHIR also provides semantic structures and terminology-binding mechanisms, although shared interpretation depends on profiling and governance.

anchor.note: p.96 l.Lines 308-313 read as the printed page; section 4.3.3 agrees

public.text: FHIR is described as delivering the syntactic and structural layer of interoperability. FHIR also provides semantic structures and terminology-binding mechanisms, although shared interpretation depends on profiling and governance.
public.suggestedRevision: Revise to explain that FHIR provides a common exchange representation, structured resources, terminology bindings, and extensibility mechanisms, but does not guarantee semantic interoperability without shared profiles and governance.
